alerts.headline: Lake Wind Advisory issued September 3 at 1:02AM PDT until September 3 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 35 mph,
locally up to 40 mph. Wave heights 1 to 3 feet on Lake Tahoe and
Pyramid Lake.

* WHERE...Greater Lake Tahoe Area, Lassen-Eastern Plumas-Eastern
Sierra Counties, Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden Area, and Western
Nevada Basin and Range including: Lake Tahoe, Pyramid Lake, Eagle
Lake, Honey Lake, Lake Davis, Frenchman Lake, Stampede Reservoir,
Donner Lake, Prosser and Boca Reservoirs, Washoe Lake, and Topaz
Lake.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM
alerts.instruction:
Check lake conditions before heading out and be prepared for a sudden
increase in winds and wave heights. Consider postponing boating
activities on the lake until a day with less wind.
